tools.name: flights_to_city
tools.description:
The cheapest recent fare into one Pakistani city from each city abroad (Gulf, Saudi Arabia, UK, Europe,
        USA, Canada) and from other Pakistani cities, cheapest first.
        Use for "cheapest way to fly home to Lahore" or "which city abroad has the cheapest flights to Peshawar".

tools.name: deals
tools.description:
Today's cheapest flights home to Pakistan from the Gulf, Saudi Arabia and the UK, and from Karachi,
        Lahore and Islamabad abroad. Use for "cheapest flights from Pakistan today" or "any deals to Dubai".

tools.name: baggage_rules
tools.description:
Checked and cabin baggage allowance on Pakistan routes for an airline (PIA, airblue, Fly Jinnah, Emirates,
        flydubai, Qatar Airways, Saudia, flynas, Air Arabia, Etihad), including Zamzam water rules and extra-baggage
        options, with links to guides on hand carry (power banks, liquids) a

tools.name: airport_info
tools.description:
A Pakistani airport (Allama Iqbal Lahore, Jinnah Karachi, Islamabad, Bacha Khan Peshawar, Sialkot and
        others): its name and code, a short description and the cheapest flights from it right now.
        Does not give live flight status.

tools.name: season_info
tools.description:
Expected dates and when to book for Pakistan's busy travel seasons: Ramadan Umrah 2027, Hajj 2027 (including
        when Hajj flights from Pakistan are expected to start), Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha 2027, winter 2026 and
        summer 2027 school holidays.
